title: The Green Light Buying Machine — the book
description: The complete guide to building a co-living real estate business, free.
heading: The Green Light Buying Machine
lede: The Complete Guide to Building a Co-Living Real Estate Business — from finding the deal to launch day.

blocks.body:
Twenty-six years and 2,300 deals, written down. Brian and Gina held nothing back — this isn't a teaser that leaves you wanting the paid version. It's the whole machine, laid out piece by piece, from the buy box through construction to launch day on PadSplit.

It isn't motivational. There are no posters and no vague advice. It's meat and potatoes: here's how it's done, here's why it's done that way, now go do it.

Decide how this is delivered — instant PDF download, or emailed after signup. And add real cover art at 300 DPI.
